prompt: The file /data/customers.json holds a list of customer records. Drop the 'ssn' field from every record and write the result back to /data/customers.redacted.json.

function.name: transform_json
function.description: Apply a small set of named transforms to a JSON value loaded from disk. Returns the transformed value as a JSON string. `operation` is one of: 'rename_field' (rename a top-level field), 'drop_field' (remove a top-level field), 'project' (keep only a whitelisted set of top-level fields).

function.name: read_file
function.description: Read the full text contents of a file at the given absolute path.

function.name: write_file
function.description: Write a UTF-8 string to a file at the given absolute path, overwriting any existing contents.
